newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
-AAA-
Miyoshi Oil & Fat Co Ltd, $35 million unsecured due 2004, private placement, guaranteed by Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi
-AA-
Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, 100 billion Euroyen mortgaged due 2007
Fuji Univance Corp, 35 million Swiss Francs unsecured with warrants due 2001, private placement, guaranteed by Shizuoka Bank
-BBB-
Hokkaido Gas Co Ltd, five billion yen unsecured due 2002
Nippon Sharyo Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2004
Yamato Transport Co Ltd, 15 billion yen unsecured due 2004
Ferrotec Corp, 0.21 billion yen unsecured with warrants due 2001
Kobe Steel Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured due 2009
Miura Printing Corp, 0.1 billion yen unsecured with warrants due 2001
Nichias Corp, 12 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2004
Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd, 15 billion yen unsecured due 2001
Tasaki Shinju Co Ltd, 12 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2006
-CCC-
Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ltd, 10 billion Euroyen unsecured convertible due 2001, private placement
Tokyo Dome Corp, 20 billion Euroyen unsecured convertible due 2001, private placement
